name: history-scrub
description: Remove a literal that must not be public (a client name, a real identity, an internal hostname, a leaked value) from a public git repo's history: census every copy, fix the tip forward, back up by SHA, rewrite the minimal range, prove the tip tree is byte-identical, push with a SHA-pinned lease — then chase what a rewrite cannot reach (refs/pull, cached views, PR edit history, GitLab hidden MR refs).
